0022600028.text: The Dallas Mavericks (4-3) host the Utah Jazz (1-6) in this Emirates NBA Cup West Group A game, Dallas's ninth game of the 2026-27 season. The Mavericks, who lost their last game, are 4th in the Southwest and 9th in the West, while the Jazz, on a five-game losing streak, are 14th in the West. Dallas is without Dereck Lively II, Max Christie, Santi Aldama, Sergio de Larrea and Tarik Biberovic, and Utah is without Jaren Jackson Jr., Jusuf Nurkic and Trey Alexander. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and they split their 2025-26 series 2-2, with Dallas winning the last meeting 138-120 in Dallas on January 17, 2026.
